repeaters.notice:
Each option’s Value is what the form submits. Edit labels freely; change a value only if whatever receives it expects the new one.

These values must match the HubSpot property group_type exactly. It is a required dropdown on the Group Journey Inquiry form, so a value HubSpot does not list gets the whole enquiry rejected. Change both together.
